sourceData.meaningMnemonic: A <radical>narwhal</radical> sitting on a <radical>stool</radical> is your <kanji>friend</kanji>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: "Hi <kanji>friend</kanji>," says the narwhal. "I must warn you about all the <reading>you</reading>ths." (<ja>ゆう</ja>)
sourceData.meaningInfo: Imagine that narwhal sitting there. It waves its flipper and says "hi friend" to you.
sourceData.readingInfo: Your narwhal friend goes on to warn you about all those youths, and how they will try to take away your friendship with their good looks and young ages.
